59:Tf79c,<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-default github-dark-default" style="--shiki-light:#1f2328;--shiki-dark:#e6edf3;--shiki-light-bg:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0d1117" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">#!/usr/bin/env node</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/**</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * PTY bridge for the Terminal component.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Browsers can't start a shell, so this small Node server does it for them:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   browser ── WebSocket ──► pty-bridge ── pseudo-terminal ──► $SHELL</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Protocol, one WebSocket per terminal:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * - text frames carry raw terminal data both ways (keystrokes in, output out);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * - a text frame that parses as {"type":"resize","cols":n,"rows":n} resizes the PTY.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * The socket closes with code 1000 when the shell exits.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Usage:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   node terminal-server/pty-bridge.mjs [--port 3457] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--token &#x3C;secret>] [--cwd &#x3C;dir>] [--shell &#x3C;path>]</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Every connection must present the token as ?token=… (printed at start, or</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * PTY_BRIDGE_TOKEN). Anyone holding it can run commands as you, so keep the</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * default 127.0.0.1 binding.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Requires Node 18+, `ws` and a PTY binding (`node-pty`); see README.md.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> */</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  console.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#D2A8FF">log</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">`  token    ${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">TOKEN</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">}`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  console.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#D2A8FF">log</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">`  url      ws://${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">HOST</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">}:${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">PORT</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">}/?token=${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">TOKEN</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">}`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">)</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> (</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> sig</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72"> of</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> [</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">"SIGINT"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">"SIGTERM"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">]) process.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#D2A8FF">on</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(sig, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">=></span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> process.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#D2A8FF">exit</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">))</span></span></code></pre>34:["$","$L52","registry/base-nova/ui/terminal-server/pty-bridge.mjs",{"html":"$59","title":"registry/base-nova/ui/terminal-server/pty-bridge.mjs","language":"javascript","lineNumbers":true,"maxHeight":420}]
5a:T3333,<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-default github-dark-default" style="--shiki-light:#1f2328;--shiki-dark:#e6edf3;--shiki-light-bg:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0d1117" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold"># PTY bridge</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">The </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`Terminal`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> component can drive a real shell on your machine. Browsers can't start processes, so this small Node server spawns your shell in a pseudo-terminal and streams it over a WebSocket.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">browser ── WebSocket ──► pty-bridge ── PTY ──► $SHELL</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## Run it</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```bash</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">npm</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF"> install</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF"> ws</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF"> node-pty</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">node</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF"> terminal-server/pty-bridge.mjs</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`node-pty`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> compiles a native module, so it needs a C++ toolchain (Xcode Command Line Tools on macOS, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`build-essential`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> and </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`python3`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> on Linux, Visual Studio Build Tools on Windows). Without one, install </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`@homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> instead; the bridge picks up either.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">It prints an address and a token:</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">PTY bridge ready</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  shell    /bin/zsh</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  cwd      /Users/you</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  address  ws://127.0.0.1:3457</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  token    3f9c…</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  url      ws://127.0.0.1:3457/?token=3f9c…</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Connect the component to the </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`url`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">:</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```tsx</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> [</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">transport</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">] </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> React.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#D2A8FF">useState</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">=></span><span style="--shiki-light:#8250DF;--shiki-dark:#D2A8FF"> createWebSocketTransport</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">"ws://127.0.0.1:3457/?token=3f9c…"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">))</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">&#x3C;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">Terminal</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> transport</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">={</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">transport</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">}</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> className</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">"h-96"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> /></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Each WebSocket gets its own shell; closing the socket ends it, and the socket closes when the shell exits.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## Options</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| Flag | Env | Default |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| --- | --- | --- |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--port &#x3C;n>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_PORT`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`3457`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--host &#x3C;addr>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_HOST`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`127.0.0.1`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--token &#x3C;secret>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_TOKEN`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | random, printed at start |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--cwd &#x3C;dir>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_CWD`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | your home directory |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--shell &#x3C;path>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_SHELL`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`$SHELL`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, else </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`/bin/bash`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> (</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`powershell.exe`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> on Windows) |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_ORIGINS`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | any; a comma-separated list of allowed page origins |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--verbose`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_VERBOSE=1`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | off |</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Needs Node 18+.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## Protocol</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> Text frames carry raw terminal data both ways: keystrokes in, output (with ANSI) out.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> A text frame </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`{"type":"resize","cols":120,"rows":32}`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> resizes the PTY. </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`createWebSocketTransport`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> sends one on connect and on every resize.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> `?cols=`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> and </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`?rows=`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> on the URL set the starting size.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> Close code </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`1000`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> means the shell exited.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## Security</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Anyone with the token can run commands as you. Keep the default </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`127.0.0.1`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> binding, don't commit the token, and set </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`PTY_BRIDGE_ORIGINS`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> to your app's origin (for example </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`http://localhost:3000`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">) so other pages can't connect even if they learn it.</span></span></code></pre>35:["$","$L52","registry/base-nova/ui/terminal-server/README.md",{"html":"$5a","title":"registry/base-nova/ui/terminal-server/README.md","language":"markdown","lineNumbers":true,"maxHeight":420}]
